name: Linux runtime (gamescope + native ARM Steam)
note: TEST r10: the base runtime trimmed to what a Steam session needs - the arm64 Steam client under gamescope and Proton's games. No kernel, firmware or boot files, no docs, headers, non-English locales or the base image's server tools; the Desktop package brings the desktop. Default Vulkan driver: Banners-Turnip Linux build 61f25904 with the kgsl_syncobj_merge fix. Built by linuxfs/build-base.sh.
